findings.title: Anchor set before acceptance and never invalidated
findings.message: The anchor is never cleared or revalidated when the anchor option is removed from Options or the selection is rejected or replaced externally. A stale anchor makes Shift ranges start from the target (first<0 fallback) silently, and a rejected click still sets the anchor, so later Shift ranges use an anchor that was never accepted.
findings.suggestion: Set the anchor only after the event is accepted, and clear it when the option disappears (in finishChoice).

findings.title: Option ID parsed from widget name
findings.message: Slicing b.Name by prefix length is fragile; the styler can run on a widget whose name differs, and it panics if the name is shorter than the prefix. Also it reads r.node from the styler goroutine without synchronization guarantees.
findings.suggestion: Capture the option id in the closure passed to FinalStyler instead of parsing the widget name.

findings.title: Toggle with duplicate IDs flips twice
findings.message: Apply's toggle path removes membership correctly, but the Toggle/Add range path from queueListSelection is wrong when a Shift range is processed: Toggle is set only with Meta without Shift, so fine. However the real issue is the `Apply` replace path returns slices.Clone(nil) as nil for empty IDs, which is fine. Low risk.
findings.suggestion: Verify behavior with duplicate IDs in e.IDs.
